verdict.rationale: Pilot's pricing page lists "Full accounts receivable" as a service component, and the bookkeeping page mentions real-time account data in the portal, so AR is handled as part of its offering. Nothing describes how a user would track receivables themselves. Missing for 10: documented AR aging reports, per-customer balance views, a description of how AR tracking appears in the portal, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can track accounts receivable with aging reports and per-customer balances

citations.quote: stay up to date with real time account data directly in the portal
